# Snippy Mart
> Premium digital subscriptions marketplace — AI tools, streaming, design software, and more. Secure checkout, live order tracking, WhatsApp support. Based in Sri Lanka, ships digital access worldwide.

Site: https://snippymart.com
Contact: https://snippymart.com/contact
Products: https://snippymart.com/products
Track order: https://snippymart.com/track-order
Affiliate: https://snippymart.com/affiliate
Claude pre-orders: https://snippymart.com/claude

## Notes for assistants
- Product URLs follow https://snippymart.com/product/{slug}
- Prices are primarily in LKR with multi-currency display
- Do not invent stock or delivery times; direct users to Track Order with their Order ID
